title: My Neighborhood
text:
My neighborhood is small and quiet. There is a big park near my house. Many children play there after school. I like to walk in the park with my dog.

There is also a small shop on my street. The shop sells bread, milk and fruit. My neighbor works in the shop. He is very friendly.

questions.text: What is near the writer's house?
What can you infer about the writer's neighborhood?
options: It is a nice place to live
It is very far from school

questions.text: How does the writer feel about the neighbor?

vocabulary.definition: a public green area where people can walk and play
kind and easy to talk to
a person who lives near you

paragraph_translations: Мій район маленький і тихий. Біля мого будинку є великий парк. Після школи там грають багато дітей. Я люблю гуляти в парку зі своїм собакою.
На моїй вулиці також є невеликий магазин. Магазин продає хліб, молоко і фрукти. Мій сусід працює в магазині. Він дуже дружелюбний.
